Job description
Phillip Riley is seeking an experienced ICT Manager.

Duties:

Engaging with the key stakeholders across the business, you will provide technology
and business leadership to a growing team and assist in the delivery of innovative solutions and the selection and implementation of a new decision support system.

Undertaking a strategic review of business requirements and current technology
systems to ensure that current and future operations are adequately supported.

This role has expanded responsibilities in terms of assisting the rest of the business to achieve its vision of strategic growth.
You will understand the importance of providing stable, accurate and responsive business solutions to stakeholders across the organisation as well
as the implementation of Business Intelligence systems to facilitate operations and planning.

Providing guidance and support to team members
Overseeing the day-to-day and security ICT systems and operations
Directing ICT operations to ensure smooth running
Developing and implementing ICT policies and procedures
Planning and forecasting equipment purchases and software development in relation to projected user requirements.
Key Skillset:

Management skills
Interpersonal and communication skills
Problem solving skills
Quick leaner and responsive
Ability to remain calm under pressure
Team working and team building skills Strong technical skills
Analytical skills
Minimum of 1 yearexperience required.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $87,500.00 – $107,500.00 per year + Superannuation

result.description:
Australian Mustard Oil is currently looking to recruit an experienced and qualified Electronic Equipment Trades Worker to join their team in Griffith, NSW. 

The successful candidate will need to undertake and possess:

-  Diagnose faults in machines, equipment, instruments and control systems by inspecting and testing them
-  Repairing, maintaining, and adjusting worn or defective parts and wiring
-  Servicing engine driven welder generators and completing diagnostics
-  Using electronic instruments and control systems to reassemble, test, operate and adjust equipment
-  Cleaning electromechanical welding appliances and engine driven welder generators
-  Using diagnostic tools to justify issues and evaluating the available information
-  Replacing failed components plus, testing products, equipment, and machinery
-  Providing instructions to clients on the correct usage of the electromechanical appliances.
 
Skills and Abilities:

-  Ideally have a minimum of 3 years’ experience as a qualified Electronic Equipment Trades Worker
-  A Certificate III in Electronics and Communications or Certificate III in Security Equipment or relevant  
-  Ability to work in a team environment 
 
Salary range is $70,000 - $85,000pa commensurate with experience

Fulltime Position available

Applications open on 2nd July 2026 and closes on  2nd August 2026. 

If you are interested in this role APPLY now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted
